findings.claim: Q3 2026（9/30止）Tyvaso 合計 $503.8M +5%；Tyvaso DPI $378.5M +13%（量增加價格調漲）；霧化 Tyvaso $125.3M -12%（美國量下滑）；Orenitram $145.0M +11%；Remodulin $122.0M -3%；Unituxin $52.3M +9%
findings.excerpt: Total Tyvaso net product sales increased five percent to $503.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026.

findings.claim: 公司稱競爭療法對 Q3 2026 霧化 Tyvaso、Tyvaso DPI、Remodulin 銷售有負面影響；前九個月 Tyvaso 合計持平 $1,413.9M，Orenitram +約8% 至 $406.3M，Remodulin -6% 至 $374.9M
findings.excerpt: We believe the availability of competitive therapies negatively impacted sales of Nebulized Tyvaso, Tyvaso DPI, and Remodulin for the three months ended September 30, 2026.

findings.claim: Tyvaso 於 IPF 適應症：TETON-1 於 2026 年 3 月達主要終點，公司計畫夏末前向 FDA 申請，CEO 稱最晚 2027 年 6 月於 IPF 上市
findings.source: MarketBeat Q4 2025 earnings call report / BusinessWire 2026-03-30
findings.excerpt: With confirmation of those results next month, we'll quickly file for approval and commercially launch into IPF not later than June 2027.

findings.claim: Remodulin 美國學名藥侵蝕有限；國際 Remodulin 營收因競爭與合約移轉價下調而減少；Liquidia Yutrepia 2025年6月上市直接與公司 treprostinil 產品競爭；公司調價通常為單位數百分比
findings.excerpt: limited erosion of Remodulin sales as a result of generic treprostinil competition in the United States

note: 未查到產業 TAM 成長共識與 2026/2027 公司營收指引；US 學名藥具體價格與市佔無數據。
